## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the blue toycar on the right of the rectangular red playingcards holder.

Task description: Place the blue toy car at the bottom of the image on the table to the right of the red rectangular card box. Right is determined by table directions in the overhead head view, independent of box orientation.

Success criteria: The toy car is immediately to the right of the playing-card box, nearly aligned front to back with moderate spacing, neither too close nor too far. The car is set down and both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above and preferentially grip straighter body sides between front and rear wheels, opening slightly wider than that section. Confirm the fingers straddle the body before closing rather than pressing the roof or gripping wheels.
- The small car is currently at the lower right of the box in the image. Use the tabletop grid to check its front-back offset so it does not remain diagonally forward just because it moved to the right.
- Keep the toy-car wheels off the table during transport, leaving clearance between the fingers and card box to avoid dragging the wheels or brushing the box.
- During placement, keep the wheels facing down and release only after they are supported by the table. Minimize sideways force as the fingers withdraw to reduce the chance that the car rolls away or tips over.
